description: This file defines a SwiftUI ViewModifier called DeepLinkAgentPromptAlert that presents an alert prompting the user to run an OpenClaw agent based on a deep link prompt managed by the NodeAppModel. It also extends the View protocol with a convenient method to apply this alert.

classes.name: DeepLinkAgentPromptAlert
classes.description: A ViewModifier that presents an alert asking the user whether to run the OpenClaw agent based on a deep link prompt stored in the app model.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Builds the view by presenting an alert when the prompt is available, and handling user actions to approve or decline the deep link prompt.

methods.name: deepLinkAgentPromptAlert
methods.description: An extension method on View to conveniently apply the DeepLinkAgentPromptAlert modifier.
